messages:
mira: Holding the 0.42.0 canary promotion — CI lint step failing in the pre-commit hook, blocking promote. Not sure if this is a flake or a config drift (black/version mismatch).
jon: link to failing job?
ci-bot: build #1284 failed on step `pre-commit` (lint)
ci-bot: ```
Run pre-commit hooks
black....................................................................Failed
- hook id: black
- exit code: 1
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/black", line 31, in <module>
    sys.exit(main())
black.InvalidConfiguration: This version of Black (19.10b0) does not support pyproject.toml option target-version
Expected >= 22.1.0
``` 
lee: ah ok — CI image is using an older system image that has black pinned older. We recently bumped pyproject.toml to use target-version. That will fail unless CI uses new base.
sam: can we just skip pre-commit in CI for this job and promote then fix infra? risky though...
mira: we shouldn't promote with lint disabled. That can hide real regressions.
jon: short-term fix: either pin black to 19-compatible config (remove target-version) or update CI image to a newer python tooling image. Which is faster?
lee: updating CI image is a 2-step change (image repo + infra rollout) but should be safe. Pinning repo config will be a code change and then revert — also messy.
sam: I can push a temporary commit to the release branch to remove the pyproject target-version line and rerun pipeline, if we want to unblock quickly. But we'll need to revert right after.
mira: prefer infra fix (update CI tooling image) since it's safer long-term. But if that delays >30m we may do the quick commit.
deploy-bot: Promotion to stable paused: requirement `CI all checks pass` not met. Manual override disabled for this release.
jon: action: @lee, can you test updating the CI image in a test branch? If green, we can cut an infra patch and rerun canary.
lee: on it, will open infra PR in 10m.
sam: if infra PR takes too long I can open the repo patch in the release branch as backup.
mira: sounds good. I'll update the release notes to mention a potential rollback if anything else pops after lint fix. tagging @sam for revert plan.
lee: infra PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/changes/492 — ran a local pipeline, pre-commit passes with new image.
jon: nice, once CI passes here, will trigger a canary rerun and then promote.
mira: thanks. I'll wait for green and then reattempt promote. If anything looks flaky post-merge we rollback to v0.41.9.
sam: noted, will stand by to revert the release branch if needed. :thumbsup:
mira: PR to fix pyproject created (for backup): https://git.internal/apps/changes/777 — only removes target-version for the short term.
ci-bot: rerun queued for build #1286
ci-bot: build #1286 succeeded (all checks)
mira: great — reattempting promote now.
deploy-bot: Promote job started for tag v0.42.0-canary
deploy-bot: Promote job completed: canary promoted to stable
mira: promotion complete. Closing this thread. Thanks everyone.
